command: cooperbench run -n coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10-stepcounter-r2 -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m vertex_ai/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/variants/stepcounter_cap40.yaml --setting coop -c 10 --backend docker --git
agent_config:
# Variant config: show "Step n of N: k left" on every turn (agent.step_counter, off by default)
# with high thinking and a $40 per-agent cost cap so cost limits never stop an agent early.
# Pass via: AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/stepcounter_cap40.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=stepcounter-r2 tools/run.sh ...
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_counter: true

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: high
      includeThoughts: true
